plot_autoresearch_progress: run the plot_progress script to generate a progress chart from a master_table.tsv file
plot_hypothesis_tree: render a hypothesis tree diagram from engine/tree.json showing experiment relationships and best path
load_tsv_experiments: create a function that reads a TSV file and returns a list of experiment dictionaries with parsed metrics
plot_metric_scatter: build a scatter plot showing kept improvements, running best line, crashes, and discarded experiments
find_best_path_in_tree: summarize the best experiment path from root to the node with lowest duration in a hypothesis tree
